gaps.sentence: He ran so fast that we lost ___ of him.
gaps.explanation: 'lose sight of somebody' = no longer see them.

gaps.sentence: By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: She was made ___ for three hours at the airport.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'be made' takes to-infinitive: was made to wait.

gaps.sentence: This is the village ___ my grandmother was born.
It was ___ a boring lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: such (+a) + adjective + noun + that… — emphasis structure.

gaps.sentence: The project ran ___ of money halfway through.
gaps.explanation: 'Run out of' = use up the supply.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ to resign after the scandal.
gaps.explanation: 'be forced to do' = be made to do unwillingly.
'Wish + would' complains about something you want to stop or change.
